verdict.rationale: Salesforce ships an official CLI (salesforcecli/cli, installed via `npm install -g @salesforce/cli`). It covers data queries against org records (`sf data query`), scratch org creation, Apex tests, and agent-oriented commands (`sf agent create`, `sf agent activate`), plus a plugin developer guide. An independent community user calls it a "passable command line tool" alongside other developer tooling. Missing for 10: in-depth evidence of AI-native CLI ergonomics such as machine-readable output for agents, and stronger hands-on corroboration than a lukewarm community mention.
